items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: The interviewee (Jerry Blumberg) confirms the interviewer's story about Johnny Glazel playing like Bunk Wilson, but does not describe a personal relationship with Glazel himself.

ctx.x: In particular, I do remember now that, uh, he told George Sabak, uh, uh, part Egyptian, he sent trumpet player he'd been in California, stopped to see him before any of us did in about 1941, actually heard him play before most of us. And Bunk played Panama for him and told him he played it the same then for him as he always had played it in the old days too. And another occasion, I remember in New York when, uh, remember this young bunch, we used to call it the Scarsdale Bunch with Bob Wilbur and, uh, what's his…

Yeah, well that's the truth actually. How can he play my style? Yeah. Bunk, I don't know if you call them completely different styles, but Bunk certainly had different facets to his playing in different situations, quite different from each other. And, uh.
